title: Costa Brava with Manu
text: Fantastic experience with the best guide we have ever engaged with on an excursion. Manu makes everything aspect fun and continues to provide exciting options. Manu’s knowledge is quite deep and he shares his information gladly. We entered as customers and left as part of his family. Highest recommendation!!
author: snapback

title: Wonderful
text: It was wonderful enjoyed everything thank goodness weather cooperated Manuel did great job
author: 772rivab

title: Great Trip, Better Guide
text: Rodrigo was amazing, he took us around, gave us interesting information, made us laugh, and was very interested in learning about us and helped us see Spain from a locals perspective. He took care of us when we needed it and always made sure we were having a great time. The trip itself was beautiful and the locations were amazing but Rodrigo’s personal touch made it far more memorable. Highly recommend him to anyone who gets the chance!
author: colinfX1654CJ

title: Tossa de Mar (con Manuel)
text: Manuel was the best tour guide ever! He was accommodating, flexible and professional. He was also bilingual which my family really appreciated. I would recommend this tour ten times over!
author: 228variniam

title: Manuel is the best!
text: Manuel was amazing. He is super friendly and energetic and he made the whole trip stress free and fun for the whole family. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful experience at Tossa Mar.
author: kaitlynrC6092AD

title: Great tour !
text: We had such a great time ! Rodrigo was our guide ! He was awesome ! He went above and beyond! He was on time picking us up ! He made sure we were comfortable! He communicated with us very well ! He made sure we had a really great time ! Highly recommend this tour ! Highly recommend Rodrigo ! All the different towns were cool ! We had so much fun !
author: H3486FKchelseal

title: Phenomenal
text: We had the most memorable time at Tossa de Mar for our daughter’s birthday! Xavi was our driver and guide and he was phenomenal! He was very detailed and made our trip enjoyable. He even gave our daughter a sweet gift for her birthday! We learned a lot from him and he has the nicest personality. We highly recommend him and this particular tour. The boat ride was exciting and Tossa de Mar is beautiful! Thank you Xavi!
